_comment: Commit-safe form, same convention as dac_digital.netlist.request.json:
the two PDK cell-model paths below are written relative to $PDK_ROOT, which
klt does NOT expand inside `sources`. Substitute your PDK install root into
a machine-local sibling first (gitignored as *.run.request.json, kept in
this directory because request-relative paths resolve against the request's
own dir):
sed "s|\$PDK_ROOT|$PDK_ROOT|g" verification/functional/dac_digital.asbuilt.request.json \
> verification/functional/dac_digital.asbuilt.run.request.json
primitives.v must precede gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0.v: the cell file references
the 4 UDPs defined in primitives.v and does not include it itself. gf180mcuD is
the variant whose liberty the flow used. No FUNCTIONAL define: only the
non-FUNCTIONAL branch of the models carries the specify blocks the SDF's
IOPATH entries annotate.
The SDF is the nominal-corner post-route SDF written by `klt sta` (sdf:true)
from layout/pnr/dac_digital.def plus the extracted SPEF of the same run
(../sta/sdf.request.json); it is retained beside this request, so this path
is portable (no environment variable). corner "typ" selects the typical
member of each min:typ:max triplet (iverilog -T typ).
env DAC_TB_TIMING=dr0008 selects the DR-0008 drive/sample schedule in
test_dac_digital.py (+3.0 ns drive after each rising edge, +7.0 ns check
after the capturing edge); the two zero-delay requests leave it unset.
